discrepancies.title: Mathematical Break-Even Volume Discrepancy
discrepancies.phase_14_7_claim: The reported break-even monthly volume was 34,722,499 assets/month ($13.9M users).
discrepancies.forensic_reality: The stated assumptions were fixed standing dedicated cluster cost of $1,509.76/month and effective serverless unit cost of $0.00033/asset. Dividing $1,509.76 by $0.00033 yields exactly 4,575,030 assets/month (~1.83M active users), not 34.7M.
discrepancies.root_cause: A script calculation in generate_phase_14_7_cost_analysis.py mistakenly divided by an extra scaling denominator.
discrepancies.remediation_in_phase_14_8: Correct the break-even calculation formula to strictly $1,509.76 / $0.00033 = 4,575,030 assets/month (~1,830,012 monthly active users) in YORVYN_PHASE_14_8_PERFORMANCE_COST_ANALYSIS.json.

discrepancies.title: Small Identity Gallery Leading to Ceiling Effect (100% Recall@1)
discrepancies.phase_14_7_claim: Garment identity retrieval achieved 100.0% Recall@1 and ROC-AUC of 1.0000 across 120 probes.
discrepancies.forensic_reality: The test gallery only contained 60 anchor identities, and query probes were photometric/geometric perturbations of the anchors, creating an artificial ceiling effect without cross-instance hard negative interference.
discrepancies.root_cause: Gallery pool size was constrained to 60 items to reduce benchmark execution duration.
discrepancies.remediation_in_phase_14_8: Expand gallery to 250+ physically distinct garment identities from diverse catalog sources; evaluate cross-photograph pairs with bootstrap confidence intervals.

discrepancies.title: Lack of Explicit Observed vs Inferred Hidden Surface Accounting
discrepancies.phase_14_7_claim: Generated 3D garment shells were exported as unified meshes without distinguishing front observed surfaces from unobserved rear surfaces.
discrepancies.forensic_reality: A single photograph only captures line-of-sight front surfaces. The rear geometry is purely an anatomical guess. Presenting the rear as verified 3D truth is scientifically invalid.
discrepancies.root_cause: Reconstruction output lacked per-vertex or per-panel confidence and observation flags.
discrepancies.remediation_in_phase_14_8: Introduce explicit multi-view provenance metadata: tag vertices with is_observed (front) vs is_inferred (rear), attach confidence scores (0.95 vs 0.60), and implement a genuine multi-view fusion pathway for dual-photo submissions.

discrepancies.title: Low Multi-Garment Recall (61.54%) & Connected-Component Merging
discrepancies.phase_14_7_claim: Per-instance recall was measured at 61.54% and complete-scene recovery at 18.33%.
discrepancies.forensic_reality: Raw connected components on SegFormer semantic masks merged overlapping garments (such as blazers over t-shirts, or sweaters over collared shirts), failing to isolate inner underlayers.
discrepancies.root_cause: The detector lacked edge-aware watershed separation and layered occlusion reasoning.
discrepancies.remediation_in_phase_14_8: Implement detection-segmentation fusion with morphological watershed splitting along waistband and lapel boundaries, raising recall to >= 80%.
